sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
🌞 Morning Routine (AM)

Cleanse

Start with the Face Wash. Gently massage onto wet skin and rinse to remove dirt and excess oil.

Prep & Treat

Apply 2–3 drops of the Skin Prep Serum on clean, dry skin. Gently pat until absorbed.

Hydrate

Finish with the AM Hyaluronic Gel. Apply evenly to lock in hydration and keep skin fresh throughout the day.

Bonus Tip - Seal the routine with a SPF 50 Sunscreen and step out freely!

🌙 Night Routine (PM)

Cleanse

Clean your face again using the Face Wash to remove impurities accumulated during the day.

Prep & Treat

Apply the Skin Prep Serum and let it absorb fully.

Repair

Apply the PM Pigmentation Cream evenly over the face and neck. Massage gently to support overnight repair and pigmentation correction.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🌟 AM/PM Booster Kit

India’s Most-Requested Pigmentation Reset Routine

Because pigmentation needs the right routine, at the right time.

After overwhelming demand, we bring you our most value-for-money, complete AM–PM skincare system — thoughtfully designed to target pigmentation like never before, while prepping, hydrating, and repairing your skin around the clock.

This isn’t just a kit. It’s a full skincare routine packed into one power combo — no confusion, no layering stress, no unnecessary extras.

Most people treat pigmentation with one cream. We fix it with a system.

The AM/PM Booster Kit works in sync with your skin’s natural rhythm:

• 
AM protects, hydrates, and preps your skin for the day

• 
PM repairs, corrects, and restores while you sleep

• 
Skin-Prep Biphasic Serum, a lightweight serum that activates on shake to prep your skin for maximum absorption, hydration, and visible smoothness. Designed to strengthen the skin barrier, improve texture, and help actives perform better — not sit on the surface.

Add to that skin-prep cleanser [For FREE] that gently cleanses while prepping the skin for better absorption, leaving it fresh, balanced, and ready for actives. 

Skin Note - For visibly longer-lasting results, avoid frequently switching products. Consistency is key — stick to one routine and one set of products to allow your skin to adapt and deliver optimal results.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Ingredients
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Hero Ingredients 

Hyaluronic Acid

Deeply hydrates the skin, improves elasticity, and keeps skin plump and fresh throughout the day.

Papain

A natural enzyme derived from papaya that gently exfoliates dead skin cells, helps unclog pores, and enhances skin clarity—revealing a smoother, brighter complexion without irritation.

Palmitoyl Hexapeptide-12

A powerful peptide that supports skin repair, improves texture, and helps strengthen the skin barrier.

Chenopodium Quinoa Seed Extract

Rich in nutrients that nourish the skin and support resilience against daily stressors.

Apricot Kernel Oil

Provides deep nourishment, softens skin, and helps restore natural radiance.

Niacinamide

Improves skin tone, reduces the appearance of pigmentation, and enhances overall skin clarity.

 Product Benefits
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Targets Pigmentation & Dark Spots

Helps reduce uneven patches and supports clearer-looking skin.

Makes skin feel smoother, softer and more refined.

6. Easy AM–PM Routine

Lightweight, non-greasy formulas for simple daily skincare.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What is the AM/PM Booster Kit designed for?

This kit is specially formulated to target **pigmentation, uneven skin tone, dullness, and dehydration** through a complete **day & night skincare routine**. It works with your skin’s natural rhythm to deliver visible improvement in clarity and glow.

2. How soon can I see results?

Most users notice **improved hydration and brightness within the first 7–10 days**, with visible reduction in pigmentation and uneven tone by the end of the **15-day routine**, when used consistently.

3. Is this kit suitable for all skin types?

Yes. The AM/PM Booster Kit is suitable for **all skin types**, including **sensitive skin**. The formulations are gentle, non-greasy, and designed for daily use.

4. Can men use this kit?

Absolutely. The kit is **gender-neutral** and effective for anyone dealing with pigmentation, tanning, or dull skin.

5. Do I need any additional products with this kit?

No. This is a **complete AM–PM routine**. It includes a cleanser, treatment serum, daytime hydration, and nighttime pigmentation repair — nothing extra required.

6. What makes this kit different from regular pigmentation creams?

Unlike single-step products, this kit follows a **layered, science-backed routine**:

* Cleanses & preps skin

* Treats with active peptides and botanicals

* Hydrates during the day

* Repairs pigmentation overnight

This ensures **better absorption, better results, and long-term skin balance**.

7. Can I use makeup or sunscreen with this routine?

Yes. The AM Hyaluronic Gel layers well under **sunscreen and makeup** without pilling or heaviness. Sunscreen is highly recommended during the day for best results.

8. Is the kit safe for daily use?

Yes. All products are designed for **daily AM & PM use** and are free from harsh bleaching agents. However, consistency and proper usage are key.

9. Will the pigmentation come back after stopping?

Pigmentation depends on lifestyle, sun exposure, and skincare habits. The kit helps **reset and repair skin**, but maintaining a good routine and sun protection helps **prolong results**.

10. How should I store the products?

Store all products in a **cool, dry place away from direct sunlight** and keep the lids tightly closed.
